text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …That's weird. I thought someone was calling me…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Could this be a message from the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm the chosen one! Behold my newfound power!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Real life isn't like a cartoon. That sure would be fun, though…
